maintenance_led.reason: Sells packaged shelf-stable foods (Green Giant, Crisco, Ortega) that are consumed, not repaired or maintained items.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from grocery retailers, foodservice and consumers buying branded packaged foods, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Stated strategy is acquiring established food brands; portfolio of 50+ brands was built largely through acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Retailers and consumers can easily switch to competing packaged food brands; commodity-like grocery products.

notes: Acquisition pace has slowed recently amid divestitures and debt focus, but acquisition remains its stated strategy.
